expo.name: Exdox
expo.description: Capture, review and manage business expenses, receipts, sales and claims with Exdox.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Use the camera to capture receipts and invoices.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Use the photo library to import receipt and invoice images.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save captured receipt and invoice images to your photo library when enabled.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to sign in securely to Exdox.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Exdox to use the camera to capture receipts and invoices.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Exdox to use the microphone when capturing media.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Exdox to import receipt and invoice images from your photo library.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Exdox to use Face ID for secure sign-in.
